body:
# WTALOM!
(not to be confused with WTAOM by andithegamer)
- This is forked from Fabulously Optimized
- Includes a lot of QOLs and libraries
- Includes Voxy
- runs on my potato of a pc, the lenovo thinkpad with integrated graphics, while using all mods and BSL
- my first modpack! 
  
**Disclamer**
  WTALOM runs A LOT better in 1.21.11, with the 26.2 verion having some bugs in lighting
  
  ![WTALOM with BSL](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/yGzMMaww/images/535c129f1a82f0e20ad2bcf2577f816179d8a85d.png)
